name: Careful Power Attack (Combat)
body:
Just because your attacks are powerful doesn’t mean you throw caution to the wind.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Combat Expertise, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: When using Power Attack, you gain a +1 Dodge bonus to armor class for each -1 attack penalty in addition to the bonus damage.

Normal: The attack penalties from Combat Expertise and Power Attack stack.
